posts.text:
Musk to Texas Democrats: Our Success Came From Freedom, Not Your Favors

Elon Musk just slapped down a Wall Street Journal story claiming Texas Democrats plan to yank the "white-glove treatment" for SpaceX and Tesla now that they've flipped the state. He made it plain: the companies thrived here because the government stayed out of the way.

"SpaceX and Tesla have prospered in Texas, because we were not constantly operating under an oppressive and extractive state government," Musk wrote.

He explained the practical reasons too. Factories need hands-on leadership. "And I need to be close to the factories, so that I can walk the floor in person. That’s why the first major SpaceX factory was in LA and first major Tesla factory was in SF Bay Area."

Then California turned hostile. "As California became increasingly difficult, due to extreme taxes and overregulation, we moved our major domestic expansions and HQ to Texas."

This is the same pattern that hollowed out California's tech and manufacturing base. High taxes, endless rules, and politicians treating productive companies like piñatas drove the growth elsewhere. Texas offered the opposite: lower burdens, faster permitting, and room to build. Jobs followed. Investment followed. Rockets and cars got built instead of lawsuits.

Now the new Democratic leadership is signaling they want to change the deal. They talk about ending special treatment, scrutinizing land deals, slowing data centers, and reviewing incentives. Translation: they see a successful employer and reach for the regulatory toolbox. The same approach that chased SpaceX and Tesla out of California is being imported to Texas.

Musk is not asking for favors. He is stating the obvious. Companies locate where they can operate without constant extraction and interference. Texas gained by being less California. If Democrats reverse that, the next expansion, the next factory, the next launch complex will simply go somewhere else. Florida has already been mentioned. Other red states are open for business.

The left celebrates the blue wave as a rebuke to Musk's spending. What they are actually celebrating is the chance to punish the companies that create the jobs and tax base they want to spend. History shows how that ends. California wrote the playbook. Texas is now being invited to copy it.

Starlink helped save a family trapped by snowstorm in a remote area of Argentina. 

A metre of snow surrounded Rafael Da Silva’s home near Bariloche. The power was out, food and firewood had run out, and his two young daughters were sleeping in sleeping bags to stay warm.

Rafael set up a Starlink dish on his vehicle and called for help. That call got rescuers moving. They pushed through the deep snow and brought the family to safety a few hours later.

For people stranded far from help, Starlink can be lifesaving technology.

Tesla has officially started construction of its massive new $10 billion solar manufacturing facility near Houston, Texas!

Construction is expected to finish in 2028, with commercial operations starting in Q1 2029. Total direct and indirect economic impact of the project is estimated to generate ~$6.4B in state and local taxes, and increase State of Texas GDP by ~$107 billion.

The factory will be a vertically integrated solar manufacturing facility, and it'll include:
• Wafer Manufacturing
• Ingot Manufacturing
• Coating
• Metallization and Printing Lines
• Cell Testing and QC
• Automation and Material Handling
• Cleanroom and Production Support
• Site Infrastructure
• Chemical Storage and Delivery
• Utility Infrastructure
• Environmental and Safety Systems

Starlink helped save five people stranded in Kazakhstan’s snowy mountains. ♥️

Their SUV broke down about 15 km from the village of Kystau Kurchum. There was no mobile network they could use. Starlink got their call for help through and kept them in touch with rescuers, who used the connection to find them.

Crews drove about 100 km in an all-terrain vehicle and brought all five safely back to the village.

For people stranded far from help, Starlink can be lifesaving technology.
